links.comparator_used: Lift-only retrieval (evidence ranked by within-admission co-occurrence lift, no causal demotion)
links.outcome: Causal QA accuracy and rate of evidence-unsupported answers in a leakage-controlled benchmark, at fixed retrieval recall
links.effect: Accuracy 37.2% with conservative causal demotion vs 35.7% with lift-only retrieval; evidence-unsupported answers reduced from 17.3% to 6.1%
links.quote: In a leakage-controlled causal QA benchmark, lift-only retrieval achieves 35.7% accuracy; conservative causal demotion achieves 37.2% while reducing evidence-unsupported answers from 17.3% to 6.1% at fixed retrieval recall.

design_hint: validation signal audit (lift filtering, causal demotion) for LLM-mined knowledge graph retrieval
